open_questions.question: KV40 and CCS are not confirmed for the specific Luberef PRIMA 500 product represented by DL2-12172.pdf.

Document discrepancy requiring review (not a confirmed numerical contradiction): density @ 15 °C, aramcoPRIMA 500. DL2-12172.pdf p.1 ('LUBEREF GII Product Specifications*', no printed date; column 'aramcoPRIMA 500 Spec.', Typical, ASTM D-4052) prints 0.867 with no unit. DL2-11773.pdf p.1 (brochure, printed pp. 8-9 'Group II' table, no printed date; column 'aramcoPRIMA 500', which carries no '*' (the footnote does not apply), Typical, D 4052) prints 0.8720 in the row 'Density @ 15°C, Kg/L'. The density field keeps the DL2-12172.pdf value with unit null; the brochure value is not entered and its unit is not applied to the specification-sheet value.

conflicts.note: Found in the evidence review of 2026-11-10.
